name: Docker Smoke Test
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  docker-smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: kha-kis/arr-dashboard
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=latest
            type=raw,value=v2.9.0

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          platforms: linux/amd64
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

      - name: Run smoke test container
        run: |
          docker run -d --name test-container \
            -p 3000:3000 \
            -e PLEX_SERVER_URL="http://localhost:32469" \
            -e TAUTULLI_API_KEY="test-key" \
            -e JELLYSEERR_API_KEY="test-key" \
            -e SONARR_API_KEY="test-key" \
            -e RADARR_API_KEY="test-key" \
            kha-kis/arr-dashboard:latest
          
          # Wait for container to start
          sleep 10
          
          # Test basic endpoints
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/analytics/health || exit 1
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/notifications/test || exit 1
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/library/cleanup/preview || exit 1
          
          # Verify container is still running
          docker ps | grep test-container || exit 1

      - name: Clean up test container
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker stop test-container || true
          docker rm test-container || true

      - name: Validate Docker image layers
        run: |
          docker inspect kha-kis/arr-dashboard:latest | jq '.[].RootFS.Layers' | wc -l
